visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with greyish-brown hair wearing a grey checkered shirt stands against a dark grey background with the YouTube logo. He holds a large black bear plushie wearing a red hat and a camera strap. He speaks enthusiastically toward the camera with wide eyes and an open mouth. (2) The scene shifts to a large, dimly lit event hall filled with a dense crowd of people seen from behind. Vibrant pink and purple spotlights illuminate the ceiling and a large stage at the far end where a screen displays 'Creator Collective 20周年盛會'. (3) On stage, two hosts, a man in a black suit and a woman in a black dress, hold microphones and gesture toward the audience. The background screen is bright pink with white text. They appear energetic, smiling as they speak to the crowd. (4) A montage of musical performances follows. A male singer in a dark graphic t-shirt performs, then a female singer in a white and blue jacket sings into a microphone. The lighting is dynamic, with flashing blue and purple tones, and the crowd records with their smartphones. (5) Several creators sit on stage for a panel discussion, including a person in a yellow shirt and another in a brown vest. They hold whiteboards and markers, looking at each other and laughing. Subtitles identify them as HOOK and others. (6) The camera focuses on the black bear plushie placed alone on a chair on the stage, representing the Taiwan Bar creator who is missing. The surrounding creators look at the plushie and laugh. (7) A man (the initial creator) walks onto the stage in the same grey checkered shirt, carrying a bag. He greets the hosts and sits down among the other creators, looking slightly flustered but smiling. (8) The creators on stage participate in a Q&A session, writing on their whiteboards. One whiteboard shows the text '叫員工想' (ask employees to think). The man in the checkered shirt holds the bear plushie while listening. (9) The man walks out of the venue into a hallway with red brick accents. He holds the bear plushie and a white YouTube gift bag. He talks to the camera in a handheld selfie style, waving goodbye. (10) A final group shot shows all creators on stage holding silver and gold YouTube play buttons, smiling and cheering. The video ends with a close-up of the bear plushie in front of the event backdrop.

The BGM maintains its energetic rhythm, blending with the high-arousal cheers of the audience in the large hall. (3) On-stage hosting begins with a professional male and female dialogue. Their voices are well-projected with rising intonations. Musical layers shift to a melodic pop segment with female vocals singing in the background during the montage. (4) Live performance clips introduce sharp transient sound events from microphones and rhythmic clapping. The vocal arousal is high as performers sing with powerful resonance. SFX like 'ding' and 'pop' are used for graphical emphasis. (5) The audio transitions to a more conversational yet crowded environment during the panel talk. Multiple voices overlap, accompanied by frequent crowd laughter and the rustling of handheld equipment. The BGM lowers slightly in volume to accommodate the speech. The BGM swells for a triumphant finale, closing with loud cheering and applause artifacts.
